chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Abī Saʿīd al-ʿUṣfūrī, from ʿAmr ibn Thābit, from Abī al-Jārūd, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Indeed, I and twelve from my offspring, and you, O ʿAlī, are the anchor of the earth — meaning its pegs and its mountains. By us, Allah has fastened the earth lest it sink with its inhabitants. So when the twelve from my offspring go away, the earth will sink with its inhabitants, and they will not be granted respite.”

key_terms.أَوْتَادَهَا: its pegs, indicating means of firm stabilization
key_terms.أَوْتَدَ: He fastened firmly or made stable
key_terms.تَسِيخَ: to sink or collapse into the ground
key_terms.جِبَالَهَا: its mountains, as symbols of firmness and support
key_terms.زِرُّ الْأَرْضِ: the anchor or central fastening of the earth
key_terms.وَاثْنَا عَشَرَ: the twelve, referring here to the divinely designated successors from the Prophet’s offspring

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the role of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and the twelve Imams عليهم السلام in the stability of the earth?
ai.summary: This hadith describes Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله, Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, and the twelve from his offspring as the divinely appointed means by which the earth is kept stable for its inhabitants. It expresses a cosmological and creedal role for the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, linking the continued order of the world to their presence.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Muhamad Bin Al Husayn, from Abu Saeed Al Asoufy, from Amro Bin Sabit, from Abu Al Jaroud, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

’ Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> and twelve from my<sup>saww</sup> children<sup>asws</sup>, and you<sup>asws</sup> O Ali<sup>asws</sup> are the anchors of the earth, meaning its pegs and its ropes. By us<sup>asws</sup> Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Stabilises the earth from subsiding with its inhabitants. So when the twelve from my<sup>saww</sup> sons<sup>asws</sup> go away, the earth would submerge its inhabitants and they would not be Given a Respite’.
en.sarwar: 17ـ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْعُصْفُورِيِّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَارُودِ عَنْ ابي جعفر (عَلَيْهِ السَّلام) قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ الله (صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِه) إِنِّي وَاثْنَيْ عَشَرَ مِنْ وُلْدِي وَأَنْتَ يَا عَلِيُّ زِرُّ الارْضِ يَعْنِي أَوْتَادَهَا وَجِبَالَهَا بِنَا أَوْتَدَ الله الارْضَ أَنْ تَسِيخَ بِأَهْلِهَا فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الاثْنَا عَشَرَ مِنْ وُلْدِي سَاخَتِ الارْضُ بِأَهْلِهَا وَلَمْ يُنْظَرُوا 17. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan from Sa‘id al-‘Usfuriy from ‘Amran ibn Thabit from abu al-Jarud from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“the Messenger of Allah has said, ‘ I and twelve persons from my descendants and you O Ali, are the securing anchor of the earth, that is, the pillars thereof and its ropes. Through us Allah has secured the earth from devouring the inhabitants. If all the twelve persons from my family will no longer be there, the earth will devour her inhabitants without delay.”
